concepts.title: Back-of-envelope serving capacity
concepts.body: Weights: 70B params at fp16 = 140 GB, so at least 2x80GB GPUs with tensor parallelism, usually 4 for KV headroom. Decode speed per user is roughly memory_bandwidth / bytes_read_per_token. On a 3.35 TB/s H100 pair with 140 GB weights, a single stream tops out near 3350 / 70 = ~48 tok/s per GPU of weights shard. Batching amortizes the weight reads across many sequences, which is why throughput scales with batch size until KV cache memory or compute saturates.
